user.title: AH Kassabon
user.description: Read Albert Heijn receipt PDFs from the AH app and track which products get more expensive.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in to AH again
reauth_confirm.description:
The AH login has expired.

1. Open [the AH login page]({url}) on a computer. If the link does not open, copy this address into the address bar:

`{url}`

2. Press F12 (Safari: Develop → Show Web Inspector), open the **Console** tab, and log in with your AH account.
3. After logging in, the page tries to open the AH app. The console or Network tab (tick **Preserve log**) then shows a link with `code=` in it, usually starting with `appie://login-exit?code=`. Copy that whole link (or just the code) and paste it below. The code only works for a few minutes.

Home Assistant then fetches the account's receipts (last 12 months, then every 6 hours) and knows the exact product on every line. It never sees your password; it keeps a login token, which **Log out** removes.

variable.name: Variable weight
variable.description: On, off, or empty to decide automatically.

sync_account.name: Fetch receipts from AH account
sync_account.description: Fetches new receipts from the logged-in AH account and links each line to its AH product.
